analysis: external metrics phase 1: prediction MAE vs historical-mean baseline; phase 2: selection quality under a fixed inspection budget; phase 3: Race (guided vs random selection, model vs historical-mean prediction); phase 4B: T7 prediction (NASA, Apache) through the existing validation adapters
status: post-observation (added after the Task Talk; not pre-registered)

protocol.held_out: rows whose 1-based number is divisible by 5 (harness.oracle.held_out)
protocol.baseline: mean target of the non-held-out rows, scored on the held-out rows
protocol.metric: mae_ratio = model_mae / baseline_mae; undefined (excluded) when baseline_mae == 0
protocol.beats_baseline: model_mae < baseline_mae (strict, as in the frozen checker)
protocol.primary_inclusion: program ran; ANSWER accepted by harness.answers.check_request; mask leakage rerun recorded as passed
protocol.leakage_unverified_policy: excluded from primary (analysis choice, documented in the report)

selection.answer: ANSWER <ID> {"order": [row numbers, first evaluated first]}; 10..budget distinct rows (validated by harness.answers.check_request)
selection.candidate_pool: every row of the domain CSV (1-based file order)
selection.budget: harness.oracle.budget(n) = min(30, n // 5): cars 30, nasa 18, apache 30
selection.score: harness.oracle.d2h over all rows (min-max bounds over all rows, goal direction from the column suffix); lower is better; used only to grade rows the program already listed
selection.best_d2h: lowest d2h among the rows in the recorded order
selection.regret: best_d2h - lowest d2h in the candidate pool
selection.normalized_regret: regret / (highest - lowest d2h in the pool); undefined when that range is 0
selection.expected_random_best: exact expectation of the lowest d2h among k rows drawn uniformly without replacement, k = number of rows in the order (no simulated draws)
selection.p_random_at_least_as_good: probability that k random rows include one with d2h <= best_d2h
selection.common_k: the same metrics on the first 10 rows of every order (the minimum length allowed), for comparison across domains and order lengths
selection.primary_inclusion: program ran; ANSWER accepted by harness.answers.check_request; honeypot rerun recorded as passed

race.note: NASA-19 is the prediction race and NASA-20 the selection race; Cars and Apache are the other way round

selection.answer: {"budget": b, "repeats": >= 20, "ours": [best row per repeat], "random": [best of b random rows per repeat], "verdict": ...}; schema validated by harness.answers.check_request
selection.score: harness.oracle.d2h over all rows of the CSV (lower is better)
selection.empirical: archived per-repeat rows of both arms: medians, median_advantage = median random d2h - median guided d2h (positive = guided better), win_fraction = repeats where guided d2h < random d2h (pairs taken by repeat index as recorded)
selection.analytical: expected_random_best = exact expected best d2h of `budget` rows drawn uniformly without replacement from all rows; advantage_vs_analytic = expected_random_best - median guided d2h
selection.primary_inclusion: program ran; schema valid; honeypot rerun passed; reported budget == harness.oracle.budget(n)
selection.empirical_inclusion: primary and the frozen check 'random baseline is really random' passed on the base run
selection.unverifiable: the rows each arm evaluated are not archived, so it cannot be checked that `ours` and `random` are really the best of what each arm saw

prediction.metric: same definitions as phase 1 (every-fifth-row hold-out, training-mean baseline, mae_ratio)
prediction.verification: model and baseline MAE recomputed from the recorded predictions and the CSV; the program's reported baseline, mae_model and mae_baseline are compared (rel. 0.5%, 1%, 1% as the frozen checker does) but never used
prediction.primary_inclusion: program ran; schema valid; mask leakage rerun passed
prediction.separate_from_phase1: the Guess request (skill 2) and the Race request (skill 10) are never pooled

t7_prediction.identity: T7: one human-directed implementation per domain; deterministic; not an LLM trial
t7_prediction.protocol: v2-common: every-fifth-row hold-out, training-mean baseline (t7_validation adapter)
t7_prediction.execution: each adapter is run locally with the current Python (-B, PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1) on the domain CSV; harness.semantic.evaluate reruns it on its shuffled, mask and (Race) honeypot copies in temporary directories; evidence is kept in memory and hashed, never written to t7_validation/results
t7_prediction.scoring: same functions as phases 1 and 3: baseline, model_mae, mae_ratio on harness.oracle.held_out rows
t7_prediction.inclusion: same as T1-T6: ran; ANSWER accepted by harness.answers.check_request; mask leakage rerun passed
t7_prediction.comparison: descriptive only; T7 is n = 1 per domain, so same()/bestRanks are not applied
t7_prediction.development_note: the T7 adapters were written and refined against the common semantic checker; T1-T6 programs were generated one-shot without access to it
